ARCADELX is a motion-sensing gaming kiosk and entertainment platform developed and operated by Nilee Games and Future Technologies

ARCADELX may be installed at malls, entertainment centres, restaurants, hotels, schools, corporate premises, gyms, events, exhibitions and other approved locations.
ARCADELX allows users to participate in interactive games using motion-sensing technology without requiring conventional controllers.
PART A — TERMS FOR CONSUMERS / PLAYERS
2. Eligibility
Users must comply with the minimum age requirements displayed at the
particular ARCADELX
location or for the
particular game
Children and minors should use ARCADELX under appropriate adult supervision where required.
Users must follow all safety instructions displayed on or around the kiosk.
Users must not use ARCADELX if they are unable to safely participate in physical movement-based gameplay.
3. QR PAYMENT AND GAMING SESSION
A player may initiate a gaming session by scanning the QR code displayed on the ARCADELX kiosk.
The applicable session fee will be displayed before payment.
Payment must be completed through the available payment method supported by the ARCADELX payment system.
A gaming session will begin only after successful payment confirmation is received by the ARCADELX system.
The session duration, game selection and other applicable conditions may be displayed on the kiosk before or after payment.
The payment made for one session is applicable only to that
particular session
unless otherwise specified.
Users must not make duplicate payments if a payment confirmation is delayed. Users should first check the payment status displayed by the system or contact support.

ARCADELX session prices may vary depending on the location, game, promotional offer or session duration.
The applicable price will be displayed to the user before payment.
All applicable taxes, if any, will be handled in accordance with applicable laws and payment/transaction requirements.
Nilee Games reserves the right to modify pricing, offers or session structures.

Payments for successfully completed gaming sessions are generally

The Company may verify the transaction with its payment gateway and system records before processing any eligible refund.
Approved refunds will normally be processed to the original payment method, subject to payment gateway and banking timelines.
Refunds may not be provided for:
Change of mind after starting a session;
Voluntary termination of a gaming session;
Failure to follow kiosk instructions;
User leaving the kiosk/location before completing the session;
User behaviour that causes interruption or termination of gameplay.
Where a payment gateway or banking system has independently failed or delayed a transaction, the applicable payment gateway/bank processing timelines may apply.
For refund-related assistance:
Email:
info@nileegames.com

ARCADELX involves physical movement and interactive gameplay.
Users should:
Maintain sufficient space around themselves;
Follow the on-screen instructions;
Follow staff/location-partner instructions;
Avoid running outside the designated playing area;
Keep bags, objects and other obstacles away from the playing area;
Avoid touching, moving or damaging the kiosk or camera;
Stop playing immediately if they feel uncomfortable, dizzy or unwell.
Users are responsible for using the kiosk responsibly and following safety instructions.
